result.summary: The image shows a narrow, one-way residential street with continuous sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. While the low traffic volume and presence of pedestrian infrastructure are positive, the lack of active traffic control and potential sightline obstructions from parked cars are notable safety concerns.

hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks a stop sign or signal, requiring pedestrians to rely on driver compliance for yielding.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.
